verdicts.reason: Both use the same scattered layout. 'Every mixed case.' is pulled away from its '20% off' headline and floats in the top middle. The purple circle is cropped at the bottom edge, and the headline sits inside it with tight edges. Proximity breaks down, and the eye wanders from the left to the top middle to the right with no clear reading order. A also leaves the CTA and 'Ends Sunday' text hanging at about x=700, so the right margin is large (~70px) and doesn't match the ~22px left margin. B pushes them to the right edge, which balances the margins against the left column, so B is slightly less lopsided.
